paras_en: PCB and IC substrate maker Xinxing (3037-TW) today (27) announced its latest financial results: Q3 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$100.52 billion, down 23.36% QoQ, up 3.58‑times YoY, earnings per share NT$6.15 for the quarter; for the first three quarters of 2026 after‑tax net profit was NT$282.1 billion, up 7.99‑fold YoY, EPS NT$17.85.

Xinxing's Q3 2026 revenue was NT$526.5 billion, a record high, with a gross margin of 28.85%, up 4.05 percentage points QoQ and 15.47 points YoY. The quarter's after‑tax net profit was NT$100.52 billion, down 23.36% QoQ but up 3.58‑times YoY, yielding EPS of NT$6.15.

For the first three quarters of 2026, Xinxing recorded revenue of NT$1,329.86 billion, a gross margin of 24.48%, up 11.2 percentage points YoY, and after‑tax net profit of NT$282.1 billion, up 7.99‑fold YoY, with EPS of NT$17.85.
Because of strong AI and HPC demand, AI products accounted for more than 60% of Xinxing's sales in the first half of 2026, and the share is expected to rise to 70% in the second half.

Institutional investors are optimistic that Xinxing will remain the Taiwanese substrate maker with the most GPU and ASIC server orders among the three major players, benefiting from the continued increase in AI server substrate area and layer count, allowing higher prices and faster capacity fill rates than peers.

As advanced packaging and IC substrate demand keeps expanding, key materials may face a roughly 20% supply gap, and some special equipment lead times exceed 30 months. Whether the supply chain can scale up fast enough to match AI platform upgrades will be a critical factor for the industry's future. Xinxing Chairman Chien Shan‑chie previously emphasized at the TPCA opening that, facing continual upgrades in AI hardware specifications, Taiwan's PCB industry must accelerate integration of upstream and downstream resources, shifting from a traditional manufacturing supply chain to a collaborative development ecosystem.

In addition to continuously increasing capital expenditures, Xinxing made another large land‑purchase on September 30 to support high‑end PCB and substrate capacity expansion in Taiwan. Through a public tender, the company spent NT$100.888 billion to acquire land and facilities in Hukou Township, Hsinchu County, covering about 19,072 ping of land and about 17,601 ping of building area. Today the board also approved an additional roughly NT$50.9 billion of long‑lead‑time equipment procurement orders.

items.title: PwC解析亞太碳定價 台灣300元天花板價格與國際差在哪？
items.title_en: PwC Analyzes Asia‑Pacific Carbon Pricing: Why Taiwan’s NT$300 Ceiling Differs from International Levels
paras: 台日韓碳費比一比！台灣已於2026年完成首次碳費繳納，共涉及240家企業與461座工廠，實收約新台幣49.7億元，價位從每噸50元到300元。放眼亞洲主要經濟體，韓國K-ETS第四階段提高拍賣比重，2026年9月加權平均價約每噸29,974韓元（約新台幣737元）；日本則推行GX-ETS強制階段，搭配每噸二氧化碳289日圓（約新台幣60元）的地球暖化對策稅，各國費率與制度設計，各有不同考量。
資誠普華綠色科技公司董事暨總經理李宗哲表示，碳費由政府設定費率，企業可依適用費率與收費排放量估算負擔；排放交易制度 （ETS）則透過排放總量或基準管理，由配額交易形成市場碳價，碳價由市場供需決定，猶如股價一樣有高有低。他建議企業除履行現行碳費義務，也可及早準備配額與交易管理，將碳成本納入既有減碳投資決策之中。
比如亞鄰的韓國K-ETS第四階段（2026至2030年）顯著提高拍賣比重並調整免費配額，透過市場拍賣機制形塑具指標性的碳價。日本GX-ETS則於2026年4月由自願階段轉入強制階段，並設定調整基準價格與參考上限價格，透過總量與拍賣機制引導企業減碳，成為亞太地區碳交易制度的重要借鏡。
借鏡國際經驗，世界銀行2026年報告指出全球已有87項直接碳定價政策，涵蓋約29%的溫室氣體排放。歐盟排放交易制度實施逾20年，納管的高耗能工業等固定設施排放量顯著下降，制度初期曾因配額過剩導致碳價偏低，後續透過收緊總量及市場穩定機制改善。
李宗哲指出，排放交易制度能否發揮成效，不僅取決於交易平台，更有賴排放總量、配額核配、市場流動性、價格穩定措施、市場監理，以及監測、申報與查驗制度的配合。總量過於寬鬆可能造成配額過剩、削弱碳價訊號；免費配額則須兼顧碳洩漏風險與減量誘因。

此外，「總量管制」若收緊過快且缺乏過渡安排，也可能增加企業轉型成本。李宗哲指出，若採配額拍賣，收入亦可依制度規定投入能源與產業轉型。台灣須依產業與能源結構設計制度，兼顧減碳效果、產業競爭力與市場穩定，並妥善規劃雙軌並行的銜接機制。環境部已提出碳費與ETS雙軌並行的方向，但具體銜接與履約安排仍待法規明定。企業不宜預設參與試行即可免除現行碳費義務；評估未來成本時，也須同時考量碳價、配額與評估履約安排，而非僅比較每噸價格。
李宗哲表示，企業可運用內部碳定價與邊際減量成本分析，檢視能源效率、製程改善及其他低碳技術的投資效益，並依不同碳價與配額情境，比較自行減量與取得配額的成本，作為資本支出與長期轉型策略的決策依據。他建議，企業應強化溫室氣體盤查、監測申報查驗及數據控制，作為成本與投資分析的基礎。對於出口歐盟碳邊境調整機制涵蓋產品的企業，還須保存產品排放與碳費實際支付佐證，整合碳數據與財務決策，全面提升長期競爭力。
paras_en: Taiwan, Japan and South Korea’s carbon fees compared! Taiwan completed its first carbon fee payments in 2026, covering 240 companies and 461 factories, collecting about NT$4.97 billion, with rates ranging from NT$50 to NT$300 per tonne. Looking at major Asian economies, South Korea’s K‑ETS Phase 4 raised the share of auctioned allowances, with a weighted‑average price of about KRW 29,974 per tonne (≈NT$737) in September 2026; Japan is moving its GX‑ETS into a mandatory phase, coupled with a global‑warming mitigation tax of ¥289 per tonne of CO₂ (≈NT$60). Each country’s rates and system design reflect different considerations.

PwC’s Green Technology Company director and general manager Li Zong‑zhe explained that carbon fees are set by the government, allowing firms to estimate their burden based on the applicable rate and their charged emissions. An emissions‑trading system (ETS) manages total emissions or baselines, creating a market carbon price through allowance trading that, like a stock price, can rise or fall. He advises companies to not only meet current carbon‑fee obligations but also to prepare early for allowance allocation and trading, incorporating carbon costs into existing decarbonisation investment decisions.

For example, neighboring South Korea’s K‑ETS Phase 4 (2026‑2030) markedly increases the auction share and adjusts free allowances, shaping a benchmark carbon price through market auctions. Japan’s GX‑ETS will shift from a voluntary to a mandatory phase in April 2026, setting a reference price and a price ceiling, and using total‑cap and auction mechanisms to guide corporate emissions cuts, becoming a key reference for carbon‑trading schemes in the Asia‑Pacific region.

Drawing on international experience, the World Bank’s 2026 report notes that 87 direct carbon‑pricing policies are in place worldwide, covering roughly 29 % of greenhouse‑gas emissions. The EU ETS, in operation for over 20 years, has significantly reduced emissions from high‑intensity industries and fixed‑source facilities; the scheme initially suffered low carbon prices due to excess allowances, but later tightened the cap and added market‑stability mechanisms to improve prices.

Li Zong‑zhe pointed out that an ETS’s effectiveness depends not only on the trading platform but also on the total emissions cap, allowance allocation, market liquidity, price‑stability measures, supervision, and the coordination of monitoring, reporting and verification systems. An overly loose cap can create surplus allowances and weaken the carbon‑price signal; free allowances must balance carbon‑leakage risk with incentives for reduction.

Moreover, if “cap‑and‑trade” is tightened too quickly without transition measures, firms’ transformation costs may rise. Li noted that auctioning allowances can generate revenue that, per the scheme’s rules, can be reinvested in energy and industrial transition. Taiwan must design its system according to its industrial and energy structure, balancing decarbonisation impact, competitiveness and market stability, and carefully plan a dual‑track transition mechanism. The Environmental Protection Administration has proposed a parallel carbon‑fee and ETS track, but detailed linkage and compliance rules remain to be legislated. Companies should not assume that pilot participation exempts them from current carbon‑fee duties; future cost assessments must consider carbon prices, allowances and compliance arrangements, not just per‑tonne fees.

Li Zong‑zhe said firms can use internal carbon pricing and marginal abatement cost analysis to evaluate the investment returns of energy efficiency, process improvements and other low‑carbon technologies, and compare the cost of internal reductions versus purchasing allowances under various price and allocation scenarios, informing capital‑expenditure and long‑term transformation strategies. He recommends strengthening greenhouse‑gas inventory, monitoring, reporting, verification and data control as the basis for cost and investment analysis. For companies whose products fall under the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism, they must retain evidence of product emissions and actual carbon‑fee payments, integrate carbon data with financial decisions, and comprehensively boost long‑term competitiveness.

items.title: 台股大吸金 9月散戶風向球創新紀錄
items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Attracts Massive Capital, September Retail Investor Sentiment Hits New Record
paras: 中央銀行今(27)日公布9月金融情況，一向被視為「散戶風向球」的證券劃撥存款餘額衝上4兆6981億元，呈現連2月上升，並創單月新高，同時，融資餘額和台股指數也創高。
央行指出，部分民眾將銀行定儲資金轉向台股，顯示台股吸引資金的熱度持續升溫，並反映在本國自然人占集中市場成交比重增至51.1%。
央行統計，9月證券劃撥餘額4兆6981億元，為連續第6個月來處4兆元以上的規模，有逐漸成為新常態之勢，同時，9月底融資餘額8343億元，較上月大增754億元，投資人信心明顯回溫，而較去年同期大增117%，顯示整體交投相當熱絡。
此外，央行也表示，本國法人占比增加至10.5%，而僑外法人降至38.3%，台股維持超過6成是由內資主導。
另一方面，央行提到，外匯存款同步創高飆上10兆591億元，創歷史新高，主要是進出口暢旺、企業海外籌資資金暫泊、海外資金回流等因素。
paras_en: The central bank released September’s financial data today (27th), showing that the securities‑allocation deposit balance—often regarded as the “retail investor sentiment gauge”—jumped to NT$4.6981 trillion, marking a second consecutive month of increase and a new monthly high, while margin financing balances and the Taiwan stock index also reached record levels.

The central bank noted that some individuals have shifted their bank time‑deposit funds into Taiwanese equities, indicating that the heat of capital inflows into the stock market continues to rise, reflected in the share of domestic natural persons in the concentrated market trading increasing to 51.1%.

According to the central bank’s statistics, the September securities‑allocation balance stood at NT$4.6981 trillion, marking the sixth consecutive month it has stayed above NT$4 trillion and suggesting this is becoming a new normal. At the end of September, margin financing stood at NT$834.3 billion, up NT$75.4 billion from the previous month, showing a clear rebound in investor confidence, and up 117% year‑on‑year, indicating very active trading overall.

In addition, the central bank said that the share of domestic institutional investors rose to 10.5% while overseas institutional investors fell to 38.3%, meaning that domestic capital continues to dominate more than 60% of the Taiwan market.

The central bank also reported that foreign‑exchange deposits hit a historic high of NT$10.0591 trillion, driven by strong import‑export activity, temporary overseas financing by companies, and repatriation of overseas funds.

items.title: 年底聖誕行情準備起跑？前提是這三大變數別來攪局
items.title_en: Is the Year‑End Christmas Rally Ready to Start? It Depends on These Three Variables Not to Disrupt It
paras: 美股進入傳統年底旺季，歷史數據顯示，10月底往往是秋季盤整結束、年末漲勢啟動的重要轉折點。不過，今年市場能否重現季節性行情，仍取決於大型科技股財報、聯準會 (Fed) 利率決策，以及美國期中選舉三大變數。
《巴隆週刊》週二 (27 日) 報導，市場技術分析師將10月27日視為值得關注的時間點。自1928年以來，標普500指數的平均走勢呈現相似模式：7月底至9月初上漲，隨後回落至10月底，再轉向年底漲勢。
今年美股走勢也大致符合這條路徑，標普500指數從夏季中段至初秋上漲約3%，之後截至週一回落約1%。
德意志銀行全球總體研究主管 Jim Reid 表示，以歷年平均表現來看，從目前時點到年底，美股走勢大致偏向上行。隨著期中選舉進入最後一週，選舉行情與年底季節性利多也在此時交會。
不過，Reid 提醒，季節性並不代表市場必然上漲，伊朗局勢、人工智慧 (AI) 與法國相關疑慮，都不會因為日曆翻頁而自動消失。
其他歷史統計也為多頭提供支撐。
金融研究機構 Bluekurtic Market Insights 指出，自1950年以來，19次美國期中選舉中，標普500指數有18次在投票前5天上漲，漲幅中位數達2.7%。
Citadel Securities 股票業務主管 Scott Rubner 則指出，從10月27日至年底，美股平均漲幅約5%，選舉年份的平均漲幅更達6%。
除了季節性因素，市場上漲家數增加，也被視為正面訊號。Rubner 表示，自9月底以來，標普500等權重指數的表現領先那斯達克100指數8.1個百分點，顯示行情參與範圍正在擴大。
他認為，過去數月指數漲勢越來越集中於少數股票，如今更多個股加入，有助於改善市場結構，尤其財報季正開始檢驗更廣泛企業的獲利表現。
LPL Financial 首席技術策略師 Adam Turnquist 也指出，截至週一收盤，標普500指數10月僅上漲約0.3%，若排除 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、輝達 (NVDA-US)、Meta (META-US) 與美光 (MU-US) 等科技權值股的拖累，漲幅原可達約2.5%。
然而，科技巨頭缺乏表現，也讓這波行情留下隱憂。
Turnquist 表示，標普500與那斯達克綜合指數走勢仍偏疲弱，需要看到後續買盤持續進場，才能確認反彈具延續性，而非超賣後的短暫回升。
Carson Group 全球市場策略師 Sonu Varghese 則擔心，市場廣度改善的背後，可能反映過去幾年支撐美股的重要動能正在轉變。
自2022年秋季本輪牛市啟動以來，高盛追蹤的AI股票指數累計大漲353%，漲幅超過標普500指數的3倍，同期非AI股票則上漲49%。
但這項領先趨勢自6月底、費城半導體指數登上歷史高點前後開始轉弱。以滾動6個月的相對報酬衡量，AI股票相較非AI股票的表現，已降至本輪牛市以來最差水準。
Varghese 表示，非AI股票領漲一週或一個月並不罕見，但這次逆轉持續更久，顯示市場可能出現了變化。
這也讓接下來幾天的事件格外關鍵。
Alphabet、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 財報，將檢驗大型科技公司的獲利與AI投資前景；週三Fed利率決策，以及下週二美國期中選舉，則可能左右市場對政策與經濟走向的判斷。
Carson Group 首席市場策略師 Ryan Detrick 指出，根據1950年以來的數據，10月28日歷來是美股全年平均表現最強的單一交易日。不過，今年市場面對的環境，包括難以判讀的Fed政策、油價與能源價格攀升，以及投資人對龐大AI支出的疑慮，仍可能干擾季節性漲勢。
Mahoney Asset Management 負責人 Ken Mahoney 表示，當前市場受到多股力量拉扯，操作環境依然艱難。雖然從現在到期中選舉後，行情仍有轉強的機會，但要確認轉折，還需要看到更多改善訊號。
paras_en: U.S. equities are entering the traditional year‑end rally season, and historical data show that the end of October is often a key turning point when the autumn consolidation ends and the year‑end uptrend begins. However, whether this year’s market can repeat the seasonal pattern still hinges on three variables: earnings from large‑cap tech stocks, the Federal Reserve’s interest‑rate decision, and the U.S. midterm elections.

Baron Weekly reported on Tuesday (the 27th) that market technologists view October 27 as a date worth watching. Since 1928, the S&P 500’s average trajectory has followed a similar pattern: a rise from late July to early September, a pullback to the end of October, and then a shift toward an end‑of‑year rally.
This year’s U.S. market has roughly followed that path, with the S&P 500 gaining about 3% from mid‑summer to early autumn and then slipping roughly 1% as of Monday.

Jim Reid, head of global macro research at Deutsche Bank, said that based on historical averages, the market is likely to trend upward from now until year‑end. With the midterms entering their final week, election‑related moves and the seasonal year‑end boost converge at this point.

Reid cautioned, however, that seasonality does not guarantee a rise; issues such as the situation in Iran, AI developments and concerns related to France will not simply disappear because the calendar turns.
Other historical statistics also support the bullish case.
Bluekurtic Market Insights, a financial research firm, noted that since 1950, in 19 U.S. midterm elections the S&P 500 has risen in the five days before voting 18 times, with a median gain of 2.7%.
Scott Rubner, head of equities at Citadel Securities, pointed out that from October 27 to year‑end the market has averaged a 5% rise, and in election years the average gain is even 6%.

Beyond seasonality, the growing number of advancing stocks is seen as a positive signal. Rubner said that since the end of September the equal‑weight S&P 500 has outperformed the Nasdaq‑100 by 8.1 percentage points, indicating that market participation is broadening.

He believes that in recent months the rally has become increasingly concentrated in a few names, and the addition of more stocks now helps improve market structure, especially as earnings season begins to test a wider range of companies’ profitability.

Adam Turnquist, chief technology strategist at LPL Financial, also noted that as of Monday’s close the S&P 500 was up only about 0.3% in October; excluding tech heavyweights Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Micron (MU‑US) would have lifted the gain to roughly 2.5%.
However, the lack of performance from the tech giants leaves a lingering concern for this rally.

Turnquist said the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite remain relatively weak and need sustained buying pressure to confirm that the rebound is durable rather than a brief bounce after an oversold condition.

Sonu Varghese, global market strategist at Carson Group, warned that the improvement in market breadth may reflect a shift in the key drivers that have supported U.S. equities over the past few years.
Since the autumn 2022 bull market began, Goldman‑Sachs‑tracked AI‑stock indices have surged 353%, more than three times the S&P 500’s gain, while non‑AI stocks rose 49% over the same period.

But that leading trend started to wane around the end of June, when the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index hit a historic high. Measured over a rolling six‑month window, AI stocks’ relative return versus non‑AI stocks has fallen to the weakest level since the start of this bull market.
Varghese said it’s not unusual for non‑AI stocks to lead for a week or a month, but this reversal has lasted longer, suggesting a possible market shift.
This makes the events of the coming days especially critical.

Earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) will test large‑cap tech profitability and AI investment outlooks; Wednesday’s Fed rate decision and next Tuesday’s U.S. midterms could sway market views on policy and economic direction.

Ryan Detrick, chief market strategist at Carson Group, noted that data since 1950 show October 28 has historically been the single strongest trading day for U.S. stocks in a calendar year. Yet this year’s environment – an ambiguous Fed stance, rising oil and energy prices, and investor worries about massive AI spending – could still disrupt the seasonal lift.

Ken Mahoney, head of Mahoney Asset Management, said the market is being pulled by multiple forces and the trading environment remains tough. While there is still a chance for the market to strengthen from now through the post‑election period, confirming a turning point will require more positive signals.

items.title: 美股沒崩、股票卻很難做 高盛直言華爾街交易已「無從下手」
items.title_en: US Stocks Aren’t Crashing, Yet Trading Is Tough – Goldman Says Wall Street Has ‘No Way to Play’
paras: 標普500指數看似堅挺，華爾街交易員卻面臨多年來最劇烈的投資策略輪動之一。
高盛資深宏觀交易員莫拉維（Bobby Molavi）在最新一期《Ruminations》中，形容過去兩到三週的市場基本上已讓人「無從下手」。指數表面平靜，機構投資組合內部卻波動劇烈，投資人每次調整部位，都可能再度受傷。
這場動盪已不只是人工智慧（AI）交易回檔。從科技股、產業價差到資金高度集中的熱門策略，接連遭遇賣壓。市場雖未崩盤，許多投資人的交易處境卻彷彿已身處崩盤之中。
AI交易退潮 多頭急著退場
過去兩週，那斯達克指數下跌逾6%，半導體股遭大舉拋售，動量策略跌幅約15%。支援AI基礎設施融資的信用工具也加劇波動，投資人開始擔心融資成本攀升，以及龐大資本支出能否帶來足夠回報。
高盛建構的AI股票組合，相對於剔除AI相關股票後的標普500指數，表現已從前波高點回落逾20%，是第二次出現如此幅度的回撤。
賣壓來源尤其值得關注。10月22日，避險基金出現2026年以來第五大規模的去槓桿，完全由多頭拋售驅動，也是2025年9月以來最大規模的多頭賣股潮。
這顯示壓力來自原本持有股票的投資人主動降低曝險。基金經理人若因風險限額、績效或流動性需求減碼，即使企業基本面沒有同步惡化，股價仍可能持續承壓。大量機構持有相似資產，也容易讓拋售形成相互強化的循環。
動量策略重挫 波動頻率超越危機年
動量策略通常集中持有先前表現強勁的股票，一旦領漲方向逆轉，相似的產業與主題部位便可能同時遭多家基金拋售。投資組合即使看似分散，仍可能承擔相同風險。
高盛數據顯示，其動量配對組合從高峰回落約43%，接近歷來最深回撤。一項在6月高點時曾領先約25%的動量策略，如今幾乎吐回全部超額報酬。
極端波動也更加頻繁。2026年以來，高盛動量配對組合已有30個交易日漲跌幅達到或超過5%，多於2000年的23天、2009年的16天及2020年的21天。
然而，今年這些交易日的平均VIX波動率指數僅約18.1，低於上述三年的23.3、31.5及29.3。換言之，大盤並未呈現危機式震盪，熱門持股與策略卻正經歷類似危機的劇烈調整。
資金轉向品質 AI支出陷兩難
高盛認為，市場正重新評估資產品質。該行美國優質股票組合的相對表現升至近12個月高點。自8月中旬以來，品質因子上漲約6%，標普500等權重指數則下跌近4%。
投資人更加青睞資產負債表穩健、獲利可靠、較不依賴外部融資的企業。AI漲勢強勁時，市場願意為遠期成長支付高額溢價，如今更在意現金流與投資回報，而非資本支出有多大。
市場也開始追問，雲端服務巨頭還能投入多少資金、融資成本會升至何種水準，以及未來獲利能否支撐巨額投資。
與此同時，美國與歐洲景氣循環股均明顯落後防禦股，反映投資人對經濟成長的信心轉弱。
石油、利率與AI，是高盛關注的三大變數。能源價格上漲增加通膨不確定性，高利率則推升AI專案融資成本。
近期美債殖利率下滑，也未明顯提振股市，因為市場擔心這反映的是AI投資放緩與經濟轉弱，而非單純通膨降溫。
企業因此陷入兩難：增加資本支出，可能因融資負擔受到市場懲罰；削減支出，又可能被解讀為成長前景惡化。
儘管交易困難，市場仍有正面訊號。標普500成分股中，股價站上50日均線的比例升至約61%，創8月以來最高，三週內增加17個百分點。
這意味著，熱門科技股承壓之際，更多股票走勢正在改善，資金過度集中的部位獲得清理，也可能為其他類股騰出空間。
不過，賣壓減弱不代表投資人會立即回頭買進。市場若要恢復持續上漲動能，仍需更明確的證據，確認AI融資壓力與整體經濟前景趨於穩定。
目前標普500指數仍接近歷史高點，企業獲利整體維持韌性，但動量策略的劇烈逆轉提醒市場，指數無法完整反映投資組合內部的風險。
下一階段的關鍵，不只是拋售何時結束，更是投資人能否重新找到承擔風險的理由。
paras_en: The S&P 500 looks resilient, but Wall Street traders are facing one of the most intense strategy rotations in years.

Goldman senior macro trader Bobby Molavi said in the latest edition of “Ruminations” that the market over the past two‑to‑three weeks has essentially left investors “with no way to play.” The index appears calm on the surface, yet portfolios are wildly volatile and every position tweak can cause fresh pain.

The turmoil isn’t just an AI‑trading pull‑back. Tech stocks, sector spreads and heavily‑crowded hot strategies have all been hit by selling pressure. The market hasn’t collapsed, but many investors feel as if they are already in a crash scenario.
AI‑trading retreat – bulls scrambling to exit

In the past two weeks the Nasdaq fell more than 6%, semiconductor stocks were dumped en masse and momentum strategies slid about 15%. Credit instruments that fund AI‑infrastructure also saw heightened volatility, prompting worries about rising financing costs and whether massive capex can deliver sufficient returns.
Goldman’s AI‑stock basket has fallen more than 20% from its prior peak relative to an S&P 500 index stripped of AI‑related stocks – the second time such a drawdown of this magnitude has occurred.

The source of the selling is worth noting. On Oct. 22 a hedge‑fund‑driven deleveraging event, the fifth‑largest since 2026, was entirely driven by long‑side selling and marked the biggest wave of long‑side stock sales since Sep. 2025.

This shows pressure is coming from investors who already own the stocks and are actively cutting exposure. When fund managers trim positions to meet risk limits, performance targets or liquidity needs, prices can stay under pressure even if company fundamentals haven’t deteriorated. Large institutions holding similar assets can create a self‑reinforcing sell‑off loop.
Momentum strategies take a beating – volatility frequency exceeds crisis years

Momentum funds typically hold stocks that have recently outperformed; when the rally reverses, similar sectors and themes can be sold by multiple funds at once. Even a seemingly diversified portfolio can end up bearing the same risk.

Goldman data show its momentum‑paired portfolio has fallen about 43% from its peak, approaching the deepest drawdowns on record. A momentum strategy that was leading by roughly 25% at its June high has now almost given back all of its excess return.

Extreme volatility is also becoming more frequent. Since the start of 2026 Goldman’s momentum‑paired portfolio has experienced 30 trading days with moves of 5% or more, compared with 23 days in 2000, 16 days in 2009 and 21 days in 2020.

Yet the average VIX on those trading days this year was only about 18.1, lower than the 23.3, 31.5 and 29.3 levels in the three earlier periods. In other words, the broad market isn’t showing crisis‑style swings, but hot stocks and strategies are undergoing crisis‑like corrections.
Capital is shifting toward quality – AI spend caught in a bind

Goldman believes the market is re‑evaluating asset quality. Its U.S. high‑quality stock basket has risen to a near‑12‑month high relative to the broader market. Since mid‑August the quality factor has risen about 6% while an equal‑weight S&P 500 has slipped close to 4%.

Investors are favoring companies with strong balance sheets, reliable earnings and less reliance on external financing. When AI was soaring, the market was willing to pay a premium for future growth; now cash flow and return on investment matter more than the sheer size of capex.
The market is also questioning how much more cloud giants can pour into projects, what financing costs will look like and whether future earnings can sustain massive investments.
At the same time, cyclical stocks in the U.S. and Europe are lagging defensive stocks, reflecting waning confidence in economic growth.
Oil, rates and AI are the three variables Goldman is watching. Higher energy prices add inflation uncertainty, while high rates push up financing costs for AI projects.

Even the recent dip in U.S. Treasury yields hasn’t noticeably lifted equities, because investors worry the move reflects slowing AI spending and a weakening economy rather than a simple cooling of inflation.
Companies are thus in a dilemma: raising capex may invite market punishment via financing burdens, while cutting spend can be read as a sign of deteriorating growth prospects.

Despite the trading headwinds, there are positive signs. The share of S&P 500 constituents trading above their 50‑day moving average has risen to roughly 61%, the highest since August, up 17 percentage points in three weeks.
That suggests that while hot tech stocks are under pressure, more stocks are improving, and the over‑concentrated positions are being cleared, potentially freeing up space for other sectors.

However, weaker selling pressure doesn’t mean investors will rush back in. For the market to regain sustained upward momentum, clearer evidence is needed that AI financing stress and the broader economic outlook are stabilising.

The S&P 500 remains near historic highs and corporate earnings are broadly resilient, but the sharp reversal in momentum strategies reminds the market that the index does not fully capture the risks inside portfolios.
The next phase’s key isn’t just when the sell‑off ends, but whether investors can rediscover a compelling reason to take on risk again.

items.title: 希捷科技財報創新高仍不夠 盤後重挫6%
items.title_en: Seagate Technology’s Record Earnings Still Not Enough, Shares Drop 6% After Hours
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，希捷科技(Seagate Technology)(STX-US)股價週二(27日)下跌，這家硬碟製造商公布的強勁財報，仍未能滿足投資人。
今年初股價大幅飆漲後，華爾街近幾個月更加嚴格檢視希捷。該公司在2027會計年度第一季創下歷史新高的獲利表現，如今反而成了市場的基本預期，而非進場買進的訊號。
希捷股價週二盤後一度重挫逾6%。截至發稿，股價約報667.85美元。當日正常交易時段股價曾上漲3.7%。
希捷搭上人工智慧浪潮，獲利創下新高。AI需要並產生大量數據，企業可以將這些數據儲存在希捷的硬碟機（HDD）中。然而，資料儲存產業傳統上具景氣循環特性，只要任何跡象顯示需求可能減弱或供給可能增加，就會讓華爾街感到不安。
希捷股價上週下跌，因其主要競爭對手威騰電子(Western Digital)(WDC-US)公布財報後，儘管獲利優於市場預期，資本支出增加的問題仍讓投資人心存疑慮。希捷可能也正面臨類似情況。
根據FactSet，希捷公布截至10月2日一季調整後每股盈餘為7.68美元，高於去年同期的2.61美元，也超越華爾街預期的7.45美元。營收年增61%，達42.3億美元，高於分析師平均預估的41.5億美元。
財測同樣優於華爾街預期。希捷預估第二季調整後每股盈餘為9.20美元，上下浮動20美分，營收中間值為48億美元。分析師原先預期每股盈餘為8.66美元，營收為45億美元。
進一步檢視財報，希捷第一季的資本投資為2.11億美元。這仍落在公司長期設定的營收占比4%至6%目標區間內，但高於分析師原先預估的2.02億美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Seagate Technology (STX‑US) shares fell on Tuesday (the 27th) despite the hard‑drive maker posting a strong earnings report that still failed to satisfy investors.

After a sharp rally earlier this year, Wall Street has been scrutinizing Seagate more closely in recent months. The company posted a historic profit performance for the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal year, which has now become a baseline market expectation rather than a buying signal.
Seagate’s stock plunged more than 6% in after‑hours trading on Tuesday. At the time of writing, the price was around $667.85. During regular trading hours the stock had risen 3.7%.

Seagate is riding the artificial‑intelligence wave, with profits hitting new highs. AI generates massive amounts of data that enterprises can store on Seagate’s hard‑disk drives (HDDs). However, the data‑storage industry traditionally follows a cyclical pattern, and any hint of weakening demand or rising supply makes Wall Street uneasy.

Seagate’s shares fell last week after its main rival Western Digital (WDC‑US) released earnings that, while beating expectations, raised concerns about higher capital spending. Seagate may be facing a similar situation.

According to FactSet, Seagate reported adjusted earnings of $7.68 per share for the quarter ended October 2, up from $2.61 a year earlier and above Wall Street’s forecast of $7.45. Revenue grew 61% year‑over‑year to $4.23 billion, topping analysts’ average estimate of $4.15 billion.

Guidance also beat Wall Street expectations. Seagate forecasts adjusted earnings of $9.20 per share for the second quarter, plus or minus $0.20, with mid‑point revenue of $4.8 billion. Analysts had originally expected earnings of $8.66 per share and revenue of $4.5 billion.

A deeper look at the filing shows Seagate’s capital expenditures were $211 million in the first quarter. This remains within the company’s long‑term target range of 4%‑6% of revenue, but is higher than analysts’ prior estimate of $202 million.

items.title: Anthropic IPO帶旺博通！分析師升評喊買、目標價上看400美元
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Boosts Broadcom! Analyst Upgrades to Buy, Target Price Rises to $400
paras: Claude 開發商 Anthropic 申請首次公開發行 (IPO)，揭露與博通 (AVGO-US) 的龐大合作規模，帶動華爾街重新評估博通的人工智慧 (AI) 成長前景。D.A. Davidson 將博通評等由「中立」調升至「買進」，目標價從350美元上調至400美元，博通 (AVGO-US) 週二 (27日) 勁揚 4% 至每股 342.33美元，延續前一交易日約2.3%的漲勢。
《巴隆週刊》報導，Anthropic 的上市申報文件顯示，該公司對博通的承諾支出達1,612億美元。雙方原本就是重要合作夥伴，但這次揭露的交易規模，讓投資人更清楚看見 Anthropic 對博通未來業務的分量。
D.A. Davidson 分析師 Gil Luria 在週二發布的報告中指出，若 Anthropic 順利上市並募得資金，預料將為 OpenAI 明年循相同路徑上市鋪路，也有助於兩家公司持續推進與博通合作的客製化晶片計畫。
Luria 表示，OpenAI 今年稍早已募得1,220億美元，據報另有300億美元融資正在籌備中。若兩大 AI 業者資金到位，將為博通相關晶片需求提供支撐。
從合作規模來看，Luria 估計，Anthropic 從現在到2028年，將向博通採購至少16 GW 的運算容量，約占博通先前提供約32.3 GW 業務展望的一半，意味 Anthropic 將在博通未來幾年的成長中扮演關鍵角色。
估值也是此次升評的重要考量。
根據 Luria 估算，博通目前股價約為其預估2027年每股盈餘的16倍；調升後的400美元目標價，則相當於約21倍預估本益比。
不過，這筆合作也涉及博通承擔部分融資風險。
博通週一披露一項630億美元交易，由華爾街金融機構提供資金，購買博通供應的硬體，再出租給 Anthropic。
《華爾街日報》報導，博通執行長陳福陽 (Hock Tan) 曾親自出面，說服銀行完成交易。
為促成融資，博通承諾為出租設備提供最低殘值擔保。
若硬體價值下滑速度超出預期，或租賃安排無法履行，博通須承擔相關差額，首年最高財務曝險達430億美元。不過，隨著這份五年期租約推進，曝險將逐步降至零。
Truist Securities 分析師 William Stein 認為，這項交易確實涉及風險，但整體風險有限。
他指出，430億美元是最高潛在責任，只有在極度悲觀的情境下，才可能成為實際問題。
博通近幾個月股價表現承壓。如今，Anthropic 的 IPO 文件讓雙方合作規模更加明朗，加上分析師調升評等，為博通股價注入新的上漲動能。
paras_en: Claude developer Anthropic filed for an initial public offering (IPO), revealing a massive partnership with Broadcom (AVGO-US) that prompted Wall Street to reassess Broadcom's AI growth prospects. D.A. Davidson upgraded Broadcom's rating from "Neutral" to "Buy" and lifted the target price from $350 to $400, and Broadcom (AVGO-US) surged 4% on Tuesday (the 27th) to $342.33 per share, extending Tuesday's roughly 2.3% gain from the prior session.

Baron Weekly reported that Anthropic's IPO filing shows the company has committed $161.2 billion in spend to Broadcom. The two firms were already key partners, but the disclosed deal size makes investors see more clearly Anthropic's weight in Broadcom's future business.

D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria wrote in a Tuesday report that if Anthropic successfully goes public and raises capital, it is expected to pave the way for OpenAI to follow a similar IPO route next year and will also help both companies continue advancing their custom chip program with Broadcom.

Luria noted that OpenAI raised $122 billion earlier this year and, according to reports, is preparing another $30 billion financing. If the two AI giants secure their funding, it will support Broadcom's related chip demand.

Based on the partnership scale, Luria estimates Anthropic will purchase at least 16 GW of compute capacity from Broadcom through 2028, roughly half of Broadcom's previously projected 32.3 GW outlook, meaning Anthropic will play a key role in Broadcom's growth over the next few years.
Valuation was also a key factor in the rating upgrade.
According to Luria's calculations, Broadcom's current share price is about 16 times its estimated 2027 earnings per share; the upgraded $400 target price implies roughly a 21‑times forward P/E ratio.
However, the deal also exposes Broadcom to some financing risk.
Broadcom disclosed on Monday a $63 billion transaction financed by Wall Street institutions to purchase hardware supplied by Broadcom and then lease it to Anthropic.
The Wall Street Journal reported that Broadcom CEO Hock Tan personally stepped in to persuade banks to complete the transaction.
To facilitate the financing, Broadcom pledged a minimum residual value guarantee for the leased equipment.

If hardware values decline faster than expected or the lease arrangement cannot be fulfilled, Broadcom would bear the shortfall, with first‑year financial exposure topping $43 billion. The exposure is expected to taper to zero as the five‑year lease progresses.
Truist Securities analyst William Stein said the transaction does involve risk, but overall risk is limited.
He pointed out that the $43 billion represents the maximum potential liability and would only become an actual issue in an extremely pessimistic scenario.

Broadcom's stock has been under pressure in recent months. Now, Anthropic's IPO filing clarifies the scale of the partnership, and the analyst rating upgrade adds fresh upward momentum to Broadcom's share price.

items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Rises as Markets Focus on Central Bank Rate Decisions
paras: 美元周二(27日)小幅走升，市場正為一系列央行會議進行部位布局，投資人等待聯準會(Fed)等各國央行釋出新線索，以判斷經濟前景及利率走向。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週漲勢強勁的AI概念股遭到拋售，美元隨之承壓，如今則已趨於穩定。
Convera外匯與宏觀經濟策略師Kevin Ford表示，「聯準會會議前，美元已經反彈，上週之後，市場對AI的情緒也稍微穩定了一些。」
他指出，「上週股市動盪、高油價，以及法國財政壓力引發的歐洲財政問題，都讓美元受到波及。因此，我認為市場目前的反應，是稍微減輕聯準會升息所面臨的壓力。」
聯準會預計週三公布最新政策決議，歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布決策，日本銀行(BoJ)則在週五為本週的央行會議畫下句點。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，因此，焦點將落在政策制定者對未來展望釋出的任何訊號。
由Mark Cabana領銜的美銀分析師在一份給投資人的報告中表示，「若聯準會維持利率不變，美元面臨的風險偏向下行：偏鷹派的訊息大致上不會帶來太大影響，但若以偏鴿派的態度維持利率不變，美元可能面臨幅度更大的跌勢。」
歐元可能成為10月表現最差的已開發市場貨幣，兌美元本月下跌1.70%，受到高能源成本、法國政府公債市場波動，以及市場對法國財政狀況的擔憂拖累。
歐洲央行公布季度銀行放款調查後，歐元跌勢略為擴大。調查顯示，央行先前升息的影響已逐漸顯現。如果這項趨勢持續，可能在一定程度上減輕歐洲央行在明年深入推進升息的壓力。
另一方面，日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)表示，政府已準備好在外匯市場採取果斷行動，再次提醒市場，日本政府仍願意出手支撐日元。
日元上週是表現最佳主要貨幣之一，兌美元升值約0.75%，創下9月初以來最大單週漲幅。當時股市對AI的疑慮升溫，促使資金大量流入日元。
美元兌日元上漲0.24%，至157.90日元。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.19%，至1.3317美元。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Tuesday (the 27th), as markets position themselves ahead of a series of central bank meetings, with investors awaiting new clues from the Fed and other central banks to gauge economic outlook and rate trajectories.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.
AI‑related stocks that surged last week were sold off, putting pressure on the dollar, which has now stabilized.
The euro rose 0.27% against the dollar, trading at 102.29.

Convera foreign‑exchange and macro‑economics strategist Kevin Ford said, "Ahead of the Fed meeting, the dollar has already bounced back, and after last week the market sentiment on AI has also calmed somewhat."

He added, "Last week’s stock market turbulence, high oil prices, and fiscal pressures in France that sparked European fiscal concerns all impacted the dollar. Therefore, I think the market’s current reaction is to slightly ease the pressure on the Fed’s rate‑hiking path."

The Fed is expected to announce its latest policy decision on Wednesday, the European Central Bank (ECB) will release its decision on Thursday, and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will wrap up the week’s central‑bank meetings on Friday. Markets expect all three to hold rates steady, so focus will shift to any signals policymakers give about future outlooks.

Bank of America analysts led by Mark Cabana wrote in a client note, "If the Fed holds rates steady, the dollar faces a downside risk: a hawkish tone is unlikely to move markets much, but a dovish stance while holding rates could lead to a larger dollar decline."

The euro could become the worst‑performing developed‑market currency in October, having fallen 1.70% against the dollar this month, weighed down by high energy costs, volatility in France’s sovereign bond market, and concerns over French fiscal health.

After the ECB released its quarterly bank‑lending survey, the euro’s decline widened slightly. The survey showed the impact of the ECB’s earlier rate hikes is beginning to show. If this trend continues, it could somewhat relieve pressure on the ECB to push rates higher next year.

On the other hand, Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the government is ready to take decisive action in the foreign‑exchange market, reiterating that Japan remains willing to support the yen.

The yen was one of the best‑performing major currencies last week, appreciating about 0.75% against the dollar for its biggest weekly gain since early September. At that time, rising AI‑related concerns in equities drove a strong flow into the yen.
The dollar rose 0.24% against the yen, to 157.90 yen.
The pound fell 0.19% against the dollar, to $1.3317.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand and the Bank of Canada will also announce policy decisions on Wednesday, with markets expecting both to raise rates.

items.title: 博通630億美元融資案啟動 銀行團最快明年初發債210億美元
items.title_en: Broadcom Launches $63 B Financing Deal, Banking Syndicate May Issue About $21 B of Bonds Early Next Year
paras: 博通(AVGO-US) 正籌集高達 630 億美元的融資方案，旨在資助人工智慧開發商 Anthropic 採購晶片；作為該計畫的一環，參與銀行最快將於明年初發行高達 210 億美元左右的高評級公司債。
消息人士透露，美國銀行(BAC-US) 、花旗(C-US) 及摩根士丹利(MS-US) 協助安排這筆630億美元交易，預計其他銀行將在未來幾天提交參貸承諾。
銀行團將提供其中約420億美元貸款，預計最多一半將於2027年第一季透過美國投資級公司債市場再融資。
這項融資案受到華爾街與矽谷密切關注，銀行團與科技業高層希望藉此確認，投資人是否仍願意為AI計畫提供資金。
今年以來，企業已在全球各市場舉債逾4,550億美元，用於AI相關支出，但隨著後續可能湧現更多融資需求，已有跡象顯示，資產管理業者對投資這類債務日益謹慎。
這筆交易旨在協助AI模型開發商Anthropic支付資料中心晶片等設備費用，實質上由博通提供供應商融資。該架構成立了一家特殊目的公司（SPC）借款購買技術設備，再租賃給 Anthropic，並以 Anthropic 支付的租金來償還債務。
消息人士指出，其中420億美元屬於優先擔保債務，意味貸款銀行對特殊目的公司的資產享有優先受償權。博通則為這部分債務提供殘值保障，作為一種財務後盾。
據悉，銀行已承諾承貸這筆630億美元融資案中的優先擔保部分。
最終發行的公司債天期可能落在5年左右，債券本金預計將在存續期間內分期償還。發債的最終規模與時程將視市場狀況而定。
彭博先前報導，黑石(BX-US) 是其餘融資的主要出資方，承諾提供90億美元。
這是博通今年第二筆大型晶片融資案。此前，博通已完成一筆涉及阿波羅全球管理（Apollo Global Management）與黑石、規模達350億美元的交易。
另外，馬斯克旗下SpaceX(SPCX-US) 本月與阿波羅簽署約400億美元的設備融資租賃協議，用於支付推動其AI布局所需的晶片費用。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) is arranging a financing package of up to $63 billion to fund AI developer Anthropic’s chip purchases, and the participating banks could issue roughly $21 billion of high‑grade corporate bonds as early as early next year as part of the plan.

Sources say Bank of America (BAC-US), Citigroup (C-US) and Morgan Stanley (MS-US) are helping to arrange the $63 billion transaction, with other banks expected to submit participation commitments in the coming days.
The banking syndicate will provide about $42 billion in loans, with up to half expected to be refinanced in the U.S. investment‑grade corporate bond market by the first quarter of 2027.
The financing is being watched closely by Wall Street and Silicon Valley, as the banks and senior tech executives seek to confirm whether investors remain willing to fund AI projects.

Since the start of the year, companies have issued more than $455 billion of debt worldwide for AI‑related spending, but with potentially more financing needs on the horizon, asset managers are showing increasing caution toward such debt.

The deal is intended to help AI model developer Anthropic pay for data‑center chips and other equipment, effectively providing supplier financing from Broadcom. A special purpose company (SPC) will borrow to buy the technology equipment, lease it to Anthropic, and use the lease payments to service the debt.

Sources note that $42 billion of the financing is senior secured debt, meaning the lending banks have a priority claim on the SPC’s assets. Broadcom will provide a residual value guarantee for this tranche as a financial backstop.
It is understood that the banks have committed to fund the senior secured portion of the $63 billion financing package.

The final corporate bonds are likely to have a term of around five years, with principal repayments scheduled throughout the life of the issue. The ultimate size and timing of the bond issuance will depend on market conditions.
Bloomberg previously reported that Blackstone (BX-US) is the main investor for the remaining financing, committing $9 billion.
This is Broadcom’s second large chip‑financing deal of the year. Earlier, Broadcom completed a $35 billion transaction involving Apollo Global Management and Blackstone.
In addition, Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX-US) signed a roughly $40 billion equipment‑financing lease agreement with Apollo this month to cover chip costs for its AI initiatives.

paras: 2026年10月28日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股10月27日週二三大指數收紅，AI題材延續反彈，那斯達克領漲，晶片股連續第三個交易日走高。Anthropic首次公開發行（IPO）的進展提振市場氣氛，但財報好壞仍拉開個股表現；波音因虧損大於預期重挫，道瓊漲幅明顯落後。
道瓊工業指數上漲15.99點，漲幅0.03%，收52,377.57點；標普500指數上漲45.83點，漲0.60%，收7,722.60點；那斯達克綜合指數上漲308.43點，漲1.18%，收26,477.81點。美國交易所成交量為161億股，低於近20個交易日平均的171.8億股。
Anthropic上市消息帶動AI相關股票買氣回溫。不過，借款成本上升、舉債支應龐大投資能否持續，仍是本月壓抑AI股的因素。費城半導體指數雖連日反彈，仍較6月22日收盤高點回落逾兩成。
標普500十一大類股以科技股表現最強；中東和平談判受到關注，原油價格回落，能源股跌幅最大。Meta為支應AI擴張，再提高股權籌資規模，股價逆勢下跌1.6%，同屬AI題材的個股走勢仍有分歧。
財報方面，波音第三季虧損大於市場預期，股價下跌10.7%；水務設備業者Xylem下修全年財測，重挫14.2%；塗料商Sherwin-Williams單季獲利不如預期，跌2.7%，也壓抑道瓊。反觀UPS調高全年營收與獲利預測，上漲5.8%；皇家加勒比郵輪上修全年獲利展望，漲5.5%。

paras_en: On Tuesday, October 27, 2026, the three major U.S. indices closed in the green. The AI theme kept its rebound, with the Nasdaq leading the gains and chip stocks rising for the third consecutive session. Progress on Anthropic’s initial public offering lifted market sentiment, but earnings results still created a wide gap in individual stock performance; Boeing fell sharply after a larger‑than‑expected loss, leaving the Dow’s advance well behind the others.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 15.99 points, or 0.03%, to close at 52,377.57; the S&P 500 gained 45.83 points, up 0.60%, to finish at 7,722.60; and the Nasdaq Composite climbed 308.43 points, or 1.18%, to end at 26,477.81. U.S. exchange volume was 16.1 billion shares, below the 20‑day average of 17.18 billion shares.

Anthropic’s listing news revived buying interest in AI‑related stocks. However, higher borrowing costs and the need to fund massive investments remain headwinds for AI shares this month. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index, while rebounding for several days, is still more than 20% below its June 22 closing high.

Within the S&P 500’s eleven sector groups, technology stocks posted the strongest performance; Middle‑East peace talks drew attention, oil prices fell, and energy stocks suffered the biggest declines. Meta, raising additional equity to fund its AI expansion, saw its share price drop 1.6% against the trend, while other AI‑related stocks continued to move in divergent directions.

On the earnings front, Boeing reported a third‑quarter loss larger than market expectations, sending its stock down 10.7%; water‑equipment maker Xylem cut its full‑year outlook, plunging 14.2%; and paint company Sherwin‑Williams posted weaker‑than‑expected quarterly profit, slipping 2.7% and also weighing on the Dow. By contrast, UPS raised its full‑year revenue and profit forecasts, climbing 5.8%, and Royal Caribbean lifted its annual profit outlook, up 5.5%.

According to LSEG data, roughly half of the S&P 500 constituents have reported third‑quarter results, with 83% beating expectations. Microsoft and Alphabet are set to release earnings on October 28, followed by Amazon on the 29th. The Federal Reserve began a two‑day policy meeting on the 27th, and markets broadly expect the Fed to keep the federal funds rate target range at 3.75%‑4%, with the rate decision and tech‑giant earnings to follow.

items.title: 不只寫文案！沃爾瑪將AI導入門市、烘焙與物流現場 第一線員工對AI信心大增
items.title_en: Beyond Copywriting! Walmart Brings AI to Stores, Baking and Logistics, Boosting Front‑Line Staff Confidence
paras: 沃爾瑪 (Walmart) (WMT-US) 表示，人工智慧 (AI) 培訓正逐步提升員工使用相關技術的信心。這家全球零售巨頭6月首次針對全球約210萬名員工進行調查，收到超過170萬份回覆，結果顯示，77%的辦公室員工表示自己有相當程度的信心使用AI工具；在美國第一線員工中，則有84%表示自己有信心使用數位工具。沃爾瑪正透過培訓計畫，協助員工將AI應用於日常工作，並將技術能力提升視為企業轉型的重要一環。
《CNBC》報導指出，沃爾瑪人員體驗與數位解決方案資深副總裁兼人事長瑪倫・瓦格納 (Maren Waggoner) 在紐約舉行的CNBC Workforce Executive Council高階主管峰會上，公布這項員工調查結果。這次調查是公司首次大規模蒐集員工對AI及數位工具使用信心的回饋，涵蓋全球約210萬名員工，實際收到逾170萬份回覆。
沃爾瑪的AI培訓策略並非只針對科技部門，而是希望讓門市、物流、營運及辦公室員工都能掌握基本AI技能。公司先前表示，全球員工約210萬人，其中美國約160萬人，並計畫逐步讓不同職務的員工都具備一定程度的AI應用能力。
在培訓合作方面，沃爾瑪與OpenAI及Google合作，為員工提供AI認證課程，並依不同工作需求設計學習內容。相關認證透過公司內部員工學習平台提供，目標不只是讓員工認識AI，更要協助他們判讀AI生成的內容、理解工具限制，並在使用過程中保留人類判斷。
實際應用方面，門市員工可利用AI更快查找庫存商品，或透過AI協助翻譯，與使用不同語言的顧客溝通。店長可運用AI建立數位排班儀表板，商品部門員工則能將大量文字資料轉換成更容易理解的圖表，減少整理資訊所需的時間。
在生鮮與烘焙部門，AI工具也可協助員工學習食品處理及蛋糕裝飾等技能。例如，員工可拍攝蛋糕裝飾完成後的照片，由AI依據沃爾瑪內部作業指引提供回饋，協助改善技巧與作業一致性。這類應用讓AI不再只是辦公室的文字生成工具，也能進入門市現場的培訓及工作流程。
物流部門也出現類似案例。一名完成Google AI認證課程的運輸部門主管，利用所學開發應用程式，協助卡車司機尋找適合的運輸貨載，讓司機在接近工作週末時，有更好的機會安排返家行程。公司表示，這項工具有助於減少空車行駛里程、節省成本，也能協助改善司機的工作安排。
沃爾瑪人才長洛琳・斯托姆斯基 (Lorraine Stomski) 表示，公司將AI視為減少工作流程阻礙、協助員工更快學習及改善決策的工具，希望透過技術放大員工原有的能力，而非取代人與顧客之間的互動。
沃爾瑪學習策略主管喬許・艾倫 (Josh Allen) 則指出，AI培訓會依照員工的職務、技能程度與個人目標調整。對初次接觸AI的員工而言，重點在於建立基本信心；對門市或會員制商店主管而言，課程可能著重於教練指導、溝通、規劃及資訊摘要；對營運、商品管理與支援部門員工而言，則可聚焦於分析資料、簡化流程及準備後續行動。
沃爾瑪也強調，AI培訓並不是要取代員工的判斷，而是協助員工負責任地使用新工具，提升工作表現與職涯發展能力。公司希望建立一套能大規模推行、同時又能配合個別員工需求的學習模式，讓員工在工作環境持續數位化的過程中，具備相應技能。
這項策略也與沃爾瑪更廣泛的數位轉型方向一致。公司先前宣布與OpenAI合作，推動AI購物體驗及員工培訓，並在企業內部導入ChatGPT Enterprise。沃爾瑪表示，AI已應用於商品目錄改善、顧客服務及購物流程等領域，部分顧客服務案件的處理時間最多可縮短40%，服飾商品開發時程則最多可縮短18週。
此外，沃爾瑪持續透過Live Better U等教育福利提供員工學習與技能培訓。公司2025年曾表示，將延續截至2026年近10億美元的技能培訓投入，並透過沃爾瑪學院提供AI認證及其他教育機會。公司資料顯示，自2016年以來，沃爾瑪學院累計提供超過400萬次培訓完成紀錄。
隨著企業加速導入生成式AI及自動化工具，如何讓員工理解並願意使用新技術，已成為大型企業面臨的重要課題。沃爾瑪此次調查顯示，多數受訪員工對數位工具具備一定信心，但調查結果並不代表所有員工都已熟練掌握AI，也無法單憑信心程度判定培訓對生產力的實際影響。對沃爾瑪而言，下一步仍是將員工的學習成果轉化為更有效率的工作流程、更好的顧客服務，以及可衡量的營運效益。
paras_en: Walmart (WMT‑US) said AI training is gradually increasing employee confidence in using related technologies. The global retail giant surveyed roughly 2.1 million employees in June, receiving over 1.7 million responses; 77% of office staff reported a fairly high confidence in using AI tools, and 84% of front‑line workers in the United States said they feel confident using digital tools. Walmart is helping staff apply AI to daily tasks through training programs and sees upskilling as a key part of its transformation.

CNBC reported that Maren Waggoner, senior vice president of employee experience and digital solutions and chief human resources officer at Walmart, announced the survey results at the CNBC Workforce Executive Council summit in New York. This was the company’s first large‑scale collection of employee feedback on confidence in using AI and digital tools, covering about 2.1 million workers worldwide and actually receiving more than 1.7 million replies.

Walmart’s AI training strategy is not limited to the tech division; it aims to equip store, logistics, operations and office staff with basic AI skills. The company previously noted that its global workforce is about 2.1 million, with roughly 1.6 million in the United States, and plans to gradually give employees in different roles a certain level of AI capability.

In terms of training partners, Walmart works with OpenAI and Google to provide AI certification courses, tailoring learning content to various job requirements. The certifications are delivered via the company’s internal learning platform, aiming not only to introduce AI but also to help employees interpret AI‑generated content, understand tool limitations, and retain human judgment during use.

In practice, store employees can use AI to locate inventory items faster or to translate for customers speaking different languages. Store managers can employ AI to build digital scheduling dashboards, while merchandise team members can convert large text datasets into easy‑to‑read charts, cutting the time needed to organize information.

In fresh‑food and bakery sections, AI tools can help staff learn food‑handling and cake‑decorating skills. For example, an employee can photograph a finished cake and receive feedback from AI based on Walmart’s internal procedural guide, helping improve technique and consistency. Such use shows AI moving beyond office‑based text generation into in‑store training and workflows.

The logistics side has similar examples. A transportation manager who completed Google’s AI certification built an app that helps truck drivers find suitable loads, giving drivers better chances to schedule home trips as the work week ends. Walmart says the tool reduces dead‑head miles, saves costs, and improves driver scheduling.

Walmart’s chief talent officer Lorraine Stomski said the company views AI as a tool to remove workflow bottlenecks, help employees learn faster and improve decision‑making, aiming to amplify existing employee capabilities rather than replace human‑customer interaction.

Josh Allen, head of learning strategy at Walmart, noted that AI training is customized to an employee’s role, skill level and personal goals. For newcomers, the focus is building basic confidence; for store or membership‑club managers, courses may emphasize coaching, communication, planning and summarizing information; for operations, merchandising and support staff, the emphasis can be on data analysis, process simplification and action preparation.

Walmart stresses that AI training is not meant to replace employee judgment but to help staff use new tools responsibly, boosting performance and career development. The company wants a scalable learning model that also meets individual needs, ensuring workers acquire the right skills as the workplace becomes increasingly digital.

The approach aligns with Walmart’s broader digital transformation. The retailer previously announced a partnership with OpenAI to drive AI‑enhanced shopping experiences and employee training, and has deployed ChatGPT Enterprise internally. Walmart says AI is already used to improve product catalogs, customer service and shopping flows, cutting handling time for some service cases by up to 40% and shortening apparel development cycles by as much as 18 weeks.

Walmart also continues to offer education benefits such as Live Better U. In 2025 the company said it would maintain nearly $1 billion in skill‑training investment through 2026, providing AI certifications and other learning opportunities through Walmart Academy. Data show that since 2016, Walmart Academy has logged over 4 million completed training sessions.

As enterprises accelerate the rollout of generative AI and automation tools, getting employees to understand and willingly adopt new technology has become a major challenge for large firms. Walmart’s survey shows most respondents have a degree of confidence in digital tools, but the results do not mean all workers are proficient with AI, nor can confidence alone gauge the actual productivity impact of training. For Walmart, the next step is turning learning outcomes into more efficient workflows, better customer service and measurable operational benefits.

items.title: 年底聖誕行情準備起跑？前提是這三大變數別來攪局
items.title_en: Is the Year‑End Christmas Rally Ready to Start? It Depends on These Three Variables Not to Disrupt It
paras: 美股進入傳統年底旺季，歷史數據顯示，10月底往往是秋季盤整結束、年末漲勢啟動的重要轉折點。不過，今年市場能否重現季節性行情，仍取決於大型科技股財報、聯準會 (Fed) 利率決策，以及美國期中選舉三大變數。
《巴隆週刊》週二 (27 日) 報導，市場技術分析師將10月27日視為值得關注的時間點。自1928年以來，標普500指數的平均走勢呈現相似模式：7月底至9月初上漲，隨後回落至10月底，再轉向年底漲勢。
今年美股走勢也大致符合這條路徑，標普500指數從夏季中段至初秋上漲約3%，之後截至週一回落約1%。
德意志銀行全球總體研究主管 Jim Reid 表示，以歷年平均表現來看，從目前時點到年底，美股走勢大致偏向上行。隨著期中選舉進入最後一週，選舉行情與年底季節性利多也在此時交會。
不過，Reid 提醒，季節性並不代表市場必然上漲，伊朗局勢、人工智慧 (AI) 與法國相關疑慮，都不會因為日曆翻頁而自動消失。
其他歷史統計也為多頭提供支撐。
金融研究機構 Bluekurtic Market Insights 指出，自1950年以來，19次美國期中選舉中，標普500指數有18次在投票前5天上漲，漲幅中位數達2.7%。
Citadel Securities 股票業務主管 Scott Rubner 則指出，從10月27日至年底，美股平均漲幅約5%，選舉年份的平均漲幅更達6%。
除了季節性因素，市場上漲家數增加，也被視為正面訊號。Rubner 表示，自9月底以來，標普500等權重指數的表現領先那斯達克100指數8.1個百分點，顯示行情參與範圍正在擴大。
他認為，過去數月指數漲勢越來越集中於少數股票，如今更多個股加入，有助於改善市場結構，尤其財報季正開始檢驗更廣泛企業的獲利表現。
LPL Financial 首席技術策略師 Adam Turnquist 也指出，截至週一收盤，標普500指數10月僅上漲約0.3%，若排除 Alphabet (GOOGL-US)、輝達 (NVDA-US)、Meta (META-US) 與美光 (MU-US) 等科技權值股的拖累，漲幅原可達約2.5%。
然而，科技巨頭缺乏表現，也讓這波行情留下隱憂。
Turnquist 表示，標普500與那斯達克綜合指數走勢仍偏疲弱，需要看到後續買盤持續進場，才能確認反彈具延續性，而非超賣後的短暫回升。
Carson Group 全球市場策略師 Sonu Varghese 則擔心，市場廣度改善的背後，可能反映過去幾年支撐美股的重要動能正在轉變。
自2022年秋季本輪牛市啟動以來，高盛追蹤的AI股票指數累計大漲353%，漲幅超過標普500指數的3倍，同期非AI股票則上漲49%。
但這項領先趨勢自6月底、費城半導體指數登上歷史高點前後開始轉弱。以滾動6個月的相對報酬衡量，AI股票相較非AI股票的表現，已降至本輪牛市以來最差水準。
Varghese 表示，非AI股票領漲一週或一個月並不罕見，但這次逆轉持續更久，顯示市場可能出現了變化。
這也讓接下來幾天的事件格外關鍵。
Alphabet、微軟 (MSFT-US) 與亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 財報，將檢驗大型科技公司的獲利與AI投資前景；週三Fed利率決策，以及下週二美國期中選舉，則可能左右市場對政策與經濟走向的判斷。
Carson Group 首席市場策略師 Ryan Detrick 指出，根據1950年以來的數據，10月28日歷來是美股全年平均表現最強的單一交易日。不過，今年市場面對的環境，包括難以判讀的Fed政策、油價與能源價格攀升，以及投資人對龐大AI支出的疑慮，仍可能干擾季節性漲勢。
Mahoney Asset Management 負責人 Ken Mahoney 表示，當前市場受到多股力量拉扯，操作環境依然艱難。雖然從現在到期中選舉後，行情仍有轉強的機會，但要確認轉折，還需要看到更多改善訊號。
paras_en: U.S. equities are entering the traditional year‑end rally season, and historical data show that the end of October is often a key turning point when the autumn consolidation ends and the year‑end uptrend begins. However, whether this year’s market can repeat the seasonal pattern still hinges on three variables: earnings from large‑cap tech stocks, the Federal Reserve’s interest‑rate decision, and the U.S. midterm elections.

Baron Weekly reported on Tuesday (the 27th) that market technologists view October 27 as a date worth watching. Since 1928, the S&P 500’s average trajectory has followed a similar pattern: a rise from late July to early September, a pullback to the end of October, and then a shift toward an end‑of‑year rally.
This year’s U.S. market has roughly followed that path, with the S&P 500 gaining about 3% from mid‑summer to early autumn and then slipping roughly 1% as of Monday.

Jim Reid, head of global macro research at Deutsche Bank, said that based on historical averages, the market is likely to trend upward from now until year‑end. With the midterms entering their final week, election‑related moves and the seasonal year‑end boost converge at this point.

Reid cautioned, however, that seasonality does not guarantee a rise; issues such as the situation in Iran, AI developments and concerns related to France will not simply disappear because the calendar turns.
Other historical statistics also support the bullish case.
Bluekurtic Market Insights, a financial research firm, noted that since 1950, in 19 U.S. midterm elections the S&P 500 has risen in the five days before voting 18 times, with a median gain of 2.7%.
Scott Rubner, head of equities at Citadel Securities, pointed out that from October 27 to year‑end the market has averaged a 5% rise, and in election years the average gain is even 6%.

Beyond seasonality, the growing number of advancing stocks is seen as a positive signal. Rubner said that since the end of September the equal‑weight S&P 500 has outperformed the Nasdaq‑100 by 8.1 percentage points, indicating that market participation is broadening.

He believes that in recent months the rally has become increasingly concentrated in a few names, and the addition of more stocks now helps improve market structure, especially as earnings season begins to test a wider range of companies’ profitability.

Adam Turnquist, chief technology strategist at LPL Financial, also noted that as of Monday’s close the S&P 500 was up only about 0.3% in October; excluding tech heavyweights Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Meta (META‑US) and Micron (MU‑US) would have lifted the gain to roughly 2.5%.
However, the lack of performance from the tech giants leaves a lingering concern for this rally.

Turnquist said the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite remain relatively weak and need sustained buying pressure to confirm that the rebound is durable rather than a brief bounce after an oversold condition.

Sonu Varghese, global market strategist at Carson Group, warned that the improvement in market breadth may reflect a shift in the key drivers that have supported U.S. equities over the past few years.
Since the autumn 2022 bull market began, Goldman‑Sachs‑tracked AI‑stock indices have surged 353%, more than three times the S&P 500’s gain, while non‑AI stocks rose 49% over the same period.

But that leading trend started to wane around the end of June, when the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index hit a historic high. Measured over a rolling six‑month window, AI stocks’ relative return versus non‑AI stocks has fallen to the weakest level since the start of this bull market.
Varghese said it’s not unusual for non‑AI stocks to lead for a week or a month, but this reversal has lasted longer, suggesting a possible market shift.
This makes the events of the coming days especially critical.

Earnings from Alphabet, Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) will test large‑cap tech profitability and AI investment outlooks; Wednesday’s Fed rate decision and next Tuesday’s U.S. midterms could sway market views on policy and economic direction.

Ryan Detrick, chief market strategist at Carson Group, noted that data since 1950 show October 28 has historically been the single strongest trading day for U.S. stocks in a calendar year. Yet this year’s environment – an ambiguous Fed stance, rising oil and energy prices, and investor worries about massive AI spending – could still disrupt the seasonal lift.

Ken Mahoney, head of Mahoney Asset Management, said the market is being pulled by multiple forces and the trading environment remains tough. While there is still a chance for the market to strengthen from now through the post‑election period, confirming a turning point will require more positive signals.

items.title: 美股沒崩、股票卻很難做 高盛直言華爾街交易已「無從下手」
items.title_en: US Stocks Aren’t Crashing, Yet Trading Is Tough – Goldman Says Wall Street Has ‘No Way to Play’
paras: 標普500指數看似堅挺，華爾街交易員卻面臨多年來最劇烈的投資策略輪動之一。
高盛資深宏觀交易員莫拉維（Bobby Molavi）在最新一期《Ruminations》中，形容過去兩到三週的市場基本上已讓人「無從下手」。指數表面平靜，機構投資組合內部卻波動劇烈，投資人每次調整部位，都可能再度受傷。
這場動盪已不只是人工智慧（AI）交易回檔。從科技股、產業價差到資金高度集中的熱門策略，接連遭遇賣壓。市場雖未崩盤，許多投資人的交易處境卻彷彿已身處崩盤之中。
AI交易退潮 多頭急著退場
過去兩週，那斯達克指數下跌逾6%，半導體股遭大舉拋售，動量策略跌幅約15%。支援AI基礎設施融資的信用工具也加劇波動，投資人開始擔心融資成本攀升，以及龐大資本支出能否帶來足夠回報。
高盛建構的AI股票組合，相對於剔除AI相關股票後的標普500指數，表現已從前波高點回落逾20%，是第二次出現如此幅度的回撤。
賣壓來源尤其值得關注。10月22日，避險基金出現2026年以來第五大規模的去槓桿，完全由多頭拋售驅動，也是2025年9月以來最大規模的多頭賣股潮。
這顯示壓力來自原本持有股票的投資人主動降低曝險。基金經理人若因風險限額、績效或流動性需求減碼，即使企業基本面沒有同步惡化，股價仍可能持續承壓。大量機構持有相似資產，也容易讓拋售形成相互強化的循環。
動量策略重挫 波動頻率超越危機年
動量策略通常集中持有先前表現強勁的股票，一旦領漲方向逆轉，相似的產業與主題部位便可能同時遭多家基金拋售。投資組合即使看似分散，仍可能承擔相同風險。
高盛數據顯示，其動量配對組合從高峰回落約43%，接近歷來最深回撤。一項在6月高點時曾領先約25%的動量策略，如今幾乎吐回全部超額報酬。
極端波動也更加頻繁。2026年以來，高盛動量配對組合已有30個交易日漲跌幅達到或超過5%，多於2000年的23天、2009年的16天及2020年的21天。
然而，今年這些交易日的平均VIX波動率指數僅約18.1，低於上述三年的23.3、31.5及29.3。換言之，大盤並未呈現危機式震盪，熱門持股與策略卻正經歷類似危機的劇烈調整。
資金轉向品質 AI支出陷兩難
高盛認為，市場正重新評估資產品質。該行美國優質股票組合的相對表現升至近12個月高點。自8月中旬以來，品質因子上漲約6%，標普500等權重指數則下跌近4%。
投資人更加青睞資產負債表穩健、獲利可靠、較不依賴外部融資的企業。AI漲勢強勁時，市場願意為遠期成長支付高額溢價，如今更在意現金流與投資回報，而非資本支出有多大。
市場也開始追問，雲端服務巨頭還能投入多少資金、融資成本會升至何種水準，以及未來獲利能否支撐巨額投資。
與此同時，美國與歐洲景氣循環股均明顯落後防禦股，反映投資人對經濟成長的信心轉弱。
石油、利率與AI，是高盛關注的三大變數。能源價格上漲增加通膨不確定性，高利率則推升AI專案融資成本。
近期美債殖利率下滑，也未明顯提振股市，因為市場擔心這反映的是AI投資放緩與經濟轉弱，而非單純通膨降溫。
企業因此陷入兩難：增加資本支出，可能因融資負擔受到市場懲罰；削減支出，又可能被解讀為成長前景惡化。
儘管交易困難，市場仍有正面訊號。標普500成分股中，股價站上50日均線的比例升至約61%，創8月以來最高，三週內增加17個百分點。
這意味著，熱門科技股承壓之際，更多股票走勢正在改善，資金過度集中的部位獲得清理，也可能為其他類股騰出空間。
不過，賣壓減弱不代表投資人會立即回頭買進。市場若要恢復持續上漲動能，仍需更明確的證據，確認AI融資壓力與整體經濟前景趨於穩定。
目前標普500指數仍接近歷史高點，企業獲利整體維持韌性，但動量策略的劇烈逆轉提醒市場，指數無法完整反映投資組合內部的風險。
下一階段的關鍵，不只是拋售何時結束，更是投資人能否重新找到承擔風險的理由。
paras_en: The S&P 500 looks resilient, but Wall Street traders are facing one of the most intense strategy rotations in years.

Goldman senior macro trader Bobby Molavi said in the latest edition of “Ruminations” that the market over the past two‑to‑three weeks has essentially left investors “with no way to play.” The index appears calm on the surface, yet portfolios are wildly volatile and every position tweak can cause fresh pain.

The turmoil isn’t just an AI‑trading pull‑back. Tech stocks, sector spreads and heavily‑crowded hot strategies have all been hit by selling pressure. The market hasn’t collapsed, but many investors feel as if they are already in a crash scenario.
AI‑trading retreat – bulls scrambling to exit

In the past two weeks the Nasdaq fell more than 6%, semiconductor stocks were dumped en masse and momentum strategies slid about 15%. Credit instruments that fund AI‑infrastructure also saw heightened volatility, prompting worries about rising financing costs and whether massive capex can deliver sufficient returns.
Goldman’s AI‑stock basket has fallen more than 20% from its prior peak relative to an S&P 500 index stripped of AI‑related stocks – the second time such a drawdown of this magnitude has occurred.

The source of the selling is worth noting. On Oct. 22 a hedge‑fund‑driven deleveraging event, the fifth‑largest since 2026, was entirely driven by long‑side selling and marked the biggest wave of long‑side stock sales since Sep. 2025.

This shows pressure is coming from investors who already own the stocks and are actively cutting exposure. When fund managers trim positions to meet risk limits, performance targets or liquidity needs, prices can stay under pressure even if company fundamentals haven’t deteriorated. Large institutions holding similar assets can create a self‑reinforcing sell‑off loop.
Momentum strategies take a beating – volatility frequency exceeds crisis years

Momentum funds typically hold stocks that have recently outperformed; when the rally reverses, similar sectors and themes can be sold by multiple funds at once. Even a seemingly diversified portfolio can end up bearing the same risk.

Goldman data show its momentum‑paired portfolio has fallen about 43% from its peak, approaching the deepest drawdowns on record. A momentum strategy that was leading by roughly 25% at its June high has now almost given back all of its excess return.

Extreme volatility is also becoming more frequent. Since the start of 2026 Goldman’s momentum‑paired portfolio has experienced 30 trading days with moves of 5% or more, compared with 23 days in 2000, 16 days in 2009 and 21 days in 2020.

Yet the average VIX on those trading days this year was only about 18.1, lower than the 23.3, 31.5 and 29.3 levels in the three earlier periods. In other words, the broad market isn’t showing crisis‑style swings, but hot stocks and strategies are undergoing crisis‑like corrections.
Capital is shifting toward quality – AI spend caught in a bind

Goldman believes the market is re‑evaluating asset quality. Its U.S. high‑quality stock basket has risen to a near‑12‑month high relative to the broader market. Since mid‑August the quality factor has risen about 6% while an equal‑weight S&P 500 has slipped close to 4%.

Investors are favoring companies with strong balance sheets, reliable earnings and less reliance on external financing. When AI was soaring, the market was willing to pay a premium for future growth; now cash flow and return on investment matter more than the sheer size of capex.
The market is also questioning how much more cloud giants can pour into projects, what financing costs will look like and whether future earnings can sustain massive investments.
At the same time, cyclical stocks in the U.S. and Europe are lagging defensive stocks, reflecting waning confidence in economic growth.
Oil, rates and AI are the three variables Goldman is watching. Higher energy prices add inflation uncertainty, while high rates push up financing costs for AI projects.

Even the recent dip in U.S. Treasury yields hasn’t noticeably lifted equities, because investors worry the move reflects slowing AI spending and a weakening economy rather than a simple cooling of inflation.
Companies are thus in a dilemma: raising capex may invite market punishment via financing burdens, while cutting spend can be read as a sign of deteriorating growth prospects.

Despite the trading headwinds, there are positive signs. The share of S&P 500 constituents trading above their 50‑day moving average has risen to roughly 61%, the highest since August, up 17 percentage points in three weeks.
That suggests that while hot tech stocks are under pressure, more stocks are improving, and the over‑concentrated positions are being cleared, potentially freeing up space for other sectors.

However, weaker selling pressure doesn’t mean investors will rush back in. For the market to regain sustained upward momentum, clearer evidence is needed that AI financing stress and the broader economic outlook are stabilising.

The S&P 500 remains near historic highs and corporate earnings are broadly resilient, but the sharp reversal in momentum strategies reminds the market that the index does not fully capture the risks inside portfolios.
The next phase’s key isn’t just when the sell‑off ends, but whether investors can rediscover a compelling reason to take on risk again.

items.title: 希捷科技財報創新高仍不夠 盤後重挫6%
items.title_en: Seagate Technology’s Record Earnings Still Not Enough, Shares Drop 6% After Hours
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，希捷科技(Seagate Technology)(STX-US)股價週二(27日)下跌，這家硬碟製造商公布的強勁財報，仍未能滿足投資人。
今年初股價大幅飆漲後，華爾街近幾個月更加嚴格檢視希捷。該公司在2027會計年度第一季創下歷史新高的獲利表現，如今反而成了市場的基本預期，而非進場買進的訊號。
希捷股價週二盤後一度重挫逾6%。截至發稿，股價約報667.85美元。當日正常交易時段股價曾上漲3.7%。
希捷搭上人工智慧浪潮，獲利創下新高。AI需要並產生大量數據，企業可以將這些數據儲存在希捷的硬碟機（HDD）中。然而，資料儲存產業傳統上具景氣循環特性，只要任何跡象顯示需求可能減弱或供給可能增加，就會讓華爾街感到不安。
希捷股價上週下跌，因其主要競爭對手威騰電子(Western Digital)(WDC-US)公布財報後，儘管獲利優於市場預期，資本支出增加的問題仍讓投資人心存疑慮。希捷可能也正面臨類似情況。
根據FactSet，希捷公布截至10月2日一季調整後每股盈餘為7.68美元，高於去年同期的2.61美元，也超越華爾街預期的7.45美元。營收年增61%，達42.3億美元，高於分析師平均預估的41.5億美元。
財測同樣優於華爾街預期。希捷預估第二季調整後每股盈餘為9.20美元，上下浮動20美分，營收中間值為48億美元。分析師原先預期每股盈餘為8.66美元，營收為45億美元。
進一步檢視財報，希捷第一季的資本投資為2.11億美元。這仍落在公司長期設定的營收占比4%至6%目標區間內，但高於分析師原先預估的2.02億美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that Seagate Technology (STX‑US) shares fell on Tuesday (the 27th) despite the hard‑drive maker posting a strong earnings report that still failed to satisfy investors.

After a sharp rally earlier this year, Wall Street has been scrutinizing Seagate more closely in recent months. The company posted a historic profit performance for the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal year, which has now become a baseline market expectation rather than a buying signal.
Seagate’s stock plunged more than 6% in after‑hours trading on Tuesday. At the time of writing, the price was around $667.85. During regular trading hours the stock had risen 3.7%.

Seagate is riding the artificial‑intelligence wave, with profits hitting new highs. AI generates massive amounts of data that enterprises can store on Seagate’s hard‑disk drives (HDDs). However, the data‑storage industry traditionally follows a cyclical pattern, and any hint of weakening demand or rising supply makes Wall Street uneasy.

Seagate’s shares fell last week after its main rival Western Digital (WDC‑US) released earnings that, while beating expectations, raised concerns about higher capital spending. Seagate may be facing a similar situation.

According to FactSet, Seagate reported adjusted earnings of $7.68 per share for the quarter ended October 2, up from $2.61 a year earlier and above Wall Street’s forecast of $7.45. Revenue grew 61% year‑over‑year to $4.23 billion, topping analysts’ average estimate of $4.15 billion.

Guidance also beat Wall Street expectations. Seagate forecasts adjusted earnings of $9.20 per share for the second quarter, plus or minus $0.20, with mid‑point revenue of $4.8 billion. Analysts had originally expected earnings of $8.66 per share and revenue of $4.5 billion.

A deeper look at the filing shows Seagate’s capital expenditures were $211 million in the first quarter. This remains within the company’s long‑term target range of 4%‑6% of revenue, but is higher than analysts’ prior estimate of $202 million.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走升 市場聚焦各國央行利率決策會議
items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Rises as Markets Focus on Central Bank Rate Decisions
paras: 美元周二(27日)小幅走升，市場正為一系列央行會議進行部位布局，投資人等待聯準會(Fed)等各國央行釋出新線索，以判斷經濟前景及利率走向。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週漲勢強勁的AI概念股遭到拋售，美元隨之承壓，如今則已趨於穩定。
Convera外匯與宏觀經濟策略師Kevin Ford表示，「聯準會會議前，美元已經反彈，上週之後，市場對AI的情緒也稍微穩定了一些。」
他指出，「上週股市動盪、高油價，以及法國財政壓力引發的歐洲財政問題，都讓美元受到波及。因此，我認為市場目前的反應，是稍微減輕聯準會升息所面臨的壓力。」
聯準會預計週三公布最新政策決議，歐洲央行(ECB)將於週四公布決策，日本銀行(BoJ)則在週五為本週的央行會議畫下句點。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，因此，焦點將落在政策制定者對未來展望釋出的任何訊號。
由Mark Cabana領銜的美銀分析師在一份給投資人的報告中表示，「若聯準會維持利率不變，美元面臨的風險偏向下行：偏鷹派的訊息大致上不會帶來太大影響，但若以偏鴿派的態度維持利率不變，美元可能面臨幅度更大的跌勢。」
歐元可能成為10月表現最差的已開發市場貨幣，兌美元本月下跌1.70%，受到高能源成本、法國政府公債市場波動，以及市場對法國財政狀況的擔憂拖累。
歐洲央行公布季度銀行放款調查後，歐元跌勢略為擴大。調查顯示，央行先前升息的影響已逐漸顯現。如果這項趨勢持續，可能在一定程度上減輕歐洲央行在明年深入推進升息的壓力。
另一方面，日本財務大臣片山皋月(Satsuki Katayama)表示，政府已準備好在外匯市場採取果斷行動，再次提醒市場，日本政府仍願意出手支撐日元。
日元上週是表現最佳主要貨幣之一，兌美元升值約0.75%，創下9月初以來最大單週漲幅。當時股市對AI的疑慮升溫，促使資金大量流入日元。
美元兌日元上漲0.24%，至157.90日元。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.19%，至1.3317美元。
紐西蘭央行與加拿大央行也將於週三公布政策決議，市場預期兩家央行都將升息。
紐西蘭幣兌美元上漲0.08%，至0.569美元。
加拿大幣兌美元下跌0.27%，美元兌加拿大幣報1.405加幣。

美元指數報 102.3717。-0.0053%
歐元兌美元 (EUR/USD)匯率報1歐元兌1.1126美元。+0.0090%
英鎊兌美元 (GBP/USD)匯率報1英鎊兌1.3303美元。-0.0150%

美元兌加幣 (USD/CAD)匯率報1美元兌1.4046加幣。-0.0356%
美元兌日元 (USD/JPY)匯率報1美元兌157.9200日元。-0.0127%
paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Tuesday (the 27th), as markets position themselves ahead of a series of central bank meetings, with investors awaiting new clues from the Fed and other central banks to gauge economic outlook and rate trajectories.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.
AI‑related stocks that surged last week were sold off, putting pressure on the dollar, which has now stabilized.
The euro rose 0.27% against the dollar, trading at 102.29.

Convera foreign‑exchange and macro‑economics strategist Kevin Ford said, "Ahead of the Fed meeting, the dollar has already bounced back, and after last week the market sentiment on AI has also calmed somewhat."

He added, "Last week’s stock market turbulence, high oil prices, and fiscal pressures in France that sparked European fiscal concerns all impacted the dollar. Therefore, I think the market’s current reaction is to slightly ease the pressure on the Fed’s rate‑hiking path."

The Fed is expected to announce its latest policy decision on Wednesday, the European Central Bank (ECB) will release its decision on Thursday, and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) will wrap up the week’s central‑bank meetings on Friday. Markets expect all three to hold rates steady, so focus will shift to any signals policymakers give about future outlooks.

Bank of America analysts led by Mark Cabana wrote in a client note, "If the Fed holds rates steady, the dollar faces a downside risk: a hawkish tone is unlikely to move markets much, but a dovish stance while holding rates could lead to a larger dollar decline."

The euro could become the worst‑performing developed‑market currency in October, having fallen 1.70% against the dollar this month, weighed down by high energy costs, volatility in France’s sovereign bond market, and concerns over French fiscal health.

After the ECB released its quarterly bank‑lending survey, the euro’s decline widened slightly. The survey showed the impact of the ECB’s earlier rate hikes is beginning to show. If this trend continues, it could somewhat relieve pressure on the ECB to push rates higher next year.

On the other hand, Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said the government is ready to take decisive action in the foreign‑exchange market, reiterating that Japan remains willing to support the yen.

The yen was one of the best‑performing major currencies last week, appreciating about 0.75% against the dollar for its biggest weekly gain since early September. At that time, rising AI‑related concerns in equities drove a strong flow into the yen.
The dollar rose 0.24% against the yen, to 157.90 yen.
The pound fell 0.19% against the dollar, to $1.3317.
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand and the Bank of Canada will also announce policy decisions on Wednesday, with markets expecting both to raise rates.
The New Zealand dollar rose 0.08% against the dollar, to $0.569.
The Canadian dollar fell 0.27% against the dollar, with the USD/CAD at 1.405 Canadian dollars.
As of about 5:40 a.m. Taiwan time on Wednesday (the 28th):

The dollar index was at 102.3717, down 0.0053%. The euro was at 1.1126 USD (+0.0090%). The pound was at 1.3303 USD (‑0.0150%). The Australian dollar was at 0.7025 USD (‑0.0142%). The USD/CAD was at 1.4046 CAD (‑0.0356%). The USD/JPY was at 157.9200 JPY (‑0.0127%).

items.title: 〈台幣〉爆量轉升5.6分收32.452元 央行估聯準會年底再升息1碼
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Surges on Heavy Volume, Gains 5.6 ¢ to Close at 32.452 per USD; Central Bank Says Fed May Raise Rates by One More 0.25 % Point by Year‑End
paras: 新台幣今(27)日升貶互見，午盤過後爆量偏強反彈，終場兌一美元以32.452元作收，升值5.6分，台北外匯經紀公司再度擴大至27.33億美元；中央銀行在今日下午最新出爐的書面報告中提到，今年以來至10月21日外資淨匯出達776億美元，而聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼。
新台幣今日以32.53元、貶值2.2分開出後，一度貶至32.604元，午盤過後則扭轉弱勢，轉為成交爆量彈升，光是下午盤成交量就高達16.06億美元，最高來到32.452元，全日高低價差1.52角。
觀察主要亞幣，漲跌互見，日元逆勢走貶超過0.2%，韓元、新元和泰銖均貶約0.05%，反觀新台幣收升0.17%，美元指數則反彈近0.2%。
央行總裁楊金龍在今日出爐的業務報告也提到，上半年新台幣對美元貶值1.25%，主要是因國內匯市出現美元超額需求，外資淨匯出233億美元，使央行累計淨賣匯170.4億美元(約當GDP的-1.62%)，以維持國內匯市穩定。
而下半年以來，地緣政治風險導致美元避險需求升溫，加上聯準會9月升息1碼，使外資繼續淨匯出543億美元，新台幣貶值2%；累計今年以來新台幣貶值3.25%，外資淨匯出776億美元。
央行認為，聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼，支撐國際美元走勢，新台幣對美元匯率貶值。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (27th), but after the midday session it rebounded strongly on heavy volume, closing at NT$32.452 per US$1, a gain of 5.6 ¢. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanded their net buying to US$27.33 billion; the central bank’s latest written report this afternoon noted that net foreign‑capital outflows have reached US$77.6 billion up to October 21, and the Federal Reserve may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before year‑end.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.53, down 2.2 ¢, and fell to as low as NT$32.604. After the midday session it reversed the weakness, snapping up on a volume surge – the afternoon session alone saw US$16.06 billion traded, pushing the rate up to a high of NT$32.452. The intraday range was 1.52 ¢.

Among the major Asian currencies, movements were mixed: the Japanese yen fell more than 0.2% against the dollar, while the Korean won, Singapore dollar and Thai baht each slipped about 0.05%. In contrast, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.17%, and the US dollar index rebounded roughly 0.2%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long noted in today’s business report that the New Taiwan dollar depreciated 1.25% against the US dollar in the first half of the year, mainly due to excess domestic demand for dollars. Net foreign outflows of US$23.3 billion forced the bank to sell a cumulative US$17.04 billion of foreign exchange (about –1.62% of GDP) to keep the local FX market stable.

In the second half of the year, heightened geopolitical risk boosted safe‑haven demand for the dollar, and the Fed’s 0.25 percentage‑point rate hike in September prompted foreign investors to net outflow another US$54.3 billion, pushing the New Taiwan dollar down another 2%. Overall, the New Taiwan dollar has weakened 3.25% year‑to‑date, with total foreign outflows reaching US$77.6 billion.

The central bank believes the Fed may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before the end of the year, supporting the international dollar’s strength and keeping the New Taiwan dollar’s exchange rate on a depreciation trend.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】歐元區金融壓力增，衝擊歐元下挫
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Rising Eurozone Financial Pressure Hits Euro Downward
paras: ◆USD/JPY

上周密西根大學消費者調查美國10月消費者信心指數創紀錄第二低達48.0，而且標準普爾(S&P)全球公布美國10月綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)產出指數初值降至57.6，令美元承壓；此外，與人工智慧(AI)相關股票遭拋售引發避險需求升溫，推動日本公債收益率走高，並據上週五日本數據顯示9月核心消費者通貨膨脹率九個月來首次超過日本央行(BOJ)的2%目標，表明價格上漲壓力加大，強化BOJ短期內升息的理由，而且本周迎來一系列央行會議和企業財務報告，帶動資金流入日圓，週一推低美元兌日圓至156.63低點。

據市場普遍預期BOJ將在本周會議維持利率1.25%不變，並採取鷹派暫停策略，為12月加息留出空間，料升息的機率為61%，但美國9月全國活動指數為0.07及達拉斯聯邦儲備銀行10月製造業指數為13.4皆高於前值，並據芝加哥商業交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具，市場認為美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)在12月加息的概率為80%，而且主要產油國沙烏地阿拉伯及海上航運持續遭襲擊，導致油價仍接近六個月高位，推升美元兌日圓至157.64高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD
昨日路透調查多數經濟學家預測紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)週三將實施今年第三次升息，市場完全消化RBNZ加息25個基點，同時等待澳洲通貨膨脹數據週三出爐，可能決定澳洲央行(RBA)近期是否升息，支撐紐元及澳幣，而且法國社會動盪及財政捉襟見肘，但評級機構穆迪未下調該國信用評級，使法國公債拋售暫歇，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1226高點。

隨後伊福經濟研究所(Ifo)表示，德國10月企業景氣判斷指數升至90.2高於預期，但歐洲央行(ECB)調查顯示，因燃料價格上漲和成本攀升影響財務，歐元區企業從銀行獲得信貸的難度升高，而且法國抗議團體和工會呼籲10月31日舉行進一步示威，並發動11月5日全國大罷工，力圖繼續向政府施壓，社會動盪未息及預算問題惡化的擔憂打擊歐元，而且高油價對依賴能源進口的歐元區經濟構成壓力，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1172低點價位。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1175-95，支撐於1.1090-1.1110。
◆GBP/USD

paras: 美元周一(26日)上漲， 在各國央行即將召開一連串重要會議之際，歐元兌美元匯率下跌，同時原油價格持續處於高檔。另一方面，巴西總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）意外勝選後，巴西雷亞爾大幅貶值。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週由於法國政府公債遭到拋售，法國的債務風險溢酬升至自 2011 年歐洲主權債務危機以來最高，再度引發市場對歐元區可能重陷金融壓力的擔憂，歐元因此承壓。
不過，穆迪（Moody’s）上週並未調降法國的信用評等，緩解了市場部分疑慮。週一，法國政府公債（OAT）價格因此上漲，讓這個正努力改善財政困境的政府稍稍鬆了一口氣。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.21%，至每歐元 1.1179 美元。但歐元兌日元上漲 0.31%，至每歐元 176.04 日元。
法國興業銀行（Société Générale）首席外匯策略師Kit Juckes表示，「歐元面臨的基本問題並沒有改變，而且各國公債利差已經收窄。歐元目前仍容易受到衝擊，因為經濟成長前景不佳，能源價格也依然居高不下。」
布蘭特原油期貨價格雖然小幅回落，但仍維持在近六個月高點附近。油價高漲會對歐元區等仰賴能源進口的經濟體造成壓力。布蘭特原油下跌 0.78%，收於每桶 115.81 美元。
儘管美國面臨通膨上升等不利因素，但穩健的經濟數據仍為美元提供支撐。上週在科技股領跌的市場賣壓中，美元也曾面臨拋售壓力。
本週稍晚，五家主要央行將公布貨幣政策決策。市場預期，美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）都將維持利率不變，儘管通膨壓力依然存在。
紐西蘭與加拿大的央行則預計將在本週升息。
日元兌美元下跌 0.43%，至每美元 157.46 日元。
Juckes表示，「美元的表現沒有預期中那麼強勢，也面臨一些不利因素，但美國經濟數據一直相當穩健。」
巴西雷亞爾大幅下挫
巴西總統魯拉於週日勝選，取得歷史性的第四個任期。面對前總統波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）長子、參議員Flávio Bolsonaro，魯拉贏得選舉，巴西雷亞爾兌美元匯率隨即大幅下跌。
Bolsonaro在第一輪投票中領先，但在第二輪決選中以超過 400 萬票的差距落敗，震撼了原本押注他會勝選的巴西金融市場。
Bolsonaro拒絕承認敗選，並承諾將要求撤銷選舉結果。
高盛分析師團隊由Teresa Alves領銜，他們在提供投資人的研究報告中表示，「選舉結果若遭到更長時間的爭議，將對市場情緒產生負面影響。更根本的問題是，我們認為巴西雷亞爾及其他當地資產應反映更高的財政風險溢酬，尤其是近幾週政府已大幅放寬財政政策。」
分析師進一步指出，「在先前針對較差財政結果所進行的美元兌雷亞爾匯率評估中，我們認為 5.40 的匯率水準，相當於 2024 年 9 月市場所反映的財政風險溢酬；當時政府尚未在同年 11 月宣布額外的財政措施。至於 5.80 的水準，則代表更高程度的財政風險溢酬，類似於 2024 年 12 月的情況。」
巴西雷亞爾兌美元大幅下跌 8.5%，來到每美元兌 5.4 雷亞爾。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Monday (the 26th) as a series of important central‑bank meetings loom, the euro fell against the dollar, and oil prices remained high. Meanwhile, the Brazilian real sharply depreciated after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s unexpected election victory.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.

Last week, French sovereign bonds were sold off, pushing France’s debt risk premium to its highest level since the 2011 European sovereign debt crisis, reviving market worries that the euro area could once again face financial pressure, and the euro came under strain.

However, Moody’s did not downgrade France’s credit rating last week, easing some market concerns. On Monday, French OAT prices rose, giving the government, which is working to improve its fiscal situation, a slight sigh of relief.
The euro fell 0.21% to $1.1179, while the euro gained 0.31% against the yen, reaching ¥176.04 per euro.

Société Générale chief FX strategist Kit Juckes said, “The euro’s fundamental problems have not changed, and sovereign‑bond spreads have narrowed. The euro remains vulnerable because growth prospects are weak and energy prices stay high.”
Brent crude futures slipped slightly but stayed near six‑month highs. High oil prices pressure economies that rely on energy imports, such as the euro area. Brent fell 0.78% to $115.81 a barrel.

Despite adverse factors like rising inflation in the United States, solid economic data continue to support the dollar. Last week, amid market selling led by tech stocks, the dollar also faced selling pressure.

Later this week, five major central banks will announce policy decisions. Markets expect the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan to keep rates unchanged, even though inflation pressures persist.
The Reserve Banks of New Zealand and Canada are expected to raise rates this week.
The yen slipped 0.43% to ¥157.46 per dollar.
Juckes added, “The dollar’s performance is not as strong as expected and faces some headwinds, but U.S. economic data have remained quite robust.”
Brazilian real plunges
President Lula won a historic fourth term on Sunday. After defeating former President Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the real immediately fell sharply against the dollar.
Bolsonaro led in the first round but lost the runoff by more than four million votes, shocking Brazilian financial markets that had bet on his victory.
Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat and says he will seek to overturn the election results.

Goldman Sachs analysts led by Teresa Alves wrote in a research note that “If the election outcome remains contested for a longer period, market sentiment will suffer. More fundamentally, we believe the real and other local assets should reflect a higher fiscal‑risk premium, especially as the government has recently relaxed fiscal policy dramatically.”

The analysts further noted, “In our earlier USD/BRL valuation based on poorer fiscal outcomes, we considered a rate of 5.40 as reflecting the fiscal‑risk premium priced by the market in September 2024, before the government announced additional fiscal measures in November. A level of 5.80 would imply an even higher fiscal‑risk premium, similar to the situation in December 2024.”
The Brazilian real fell 8.5% against the dollar, reaching 5.4 reais per dollar.
